question: What's the best portable hi-fi speaker under $200?
query: best portable Bluetooth speakers under $200 sound quality reviews 2026

replays.text:
**My pick: JBL Flip 7**, if you can get it for under $200. What Hi-Fi? names it its best portable Bluetooth speaker and says it improves on the Flip 6’s sound and features. It’s a strong all-around choice for taking good-sounding music on the go. ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-bluetooth-speakers-portable-speakers-for-every-budget?page=1))

If you care more about a fuller sound than getting the newest model, the **JBL Charge 5** is worth considering when it’s discounted: What Hi-Fi? specifically notes it can be better value if size and sound matter more than newer features. ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-bluetooth-speakers-portable-speakers-for-every-budget?page=1))

One caveat: these are portable Bluetooth speakers, so “hi-fi” here means *good sound for a portable speaker*, not the fidelity of a larger home audio setup.

**Best pick: JBL Flip 7**—if you find it for under $200. What Hi-Fi? names it its best portable Bluetooth speaker and says it improves on the Flip 6 in sound and features. It’s a good all-round choice if you want genuinely portable sound without stepping up to a much larger speaker. ([What Hi-Fi?’s Bluetooth speaker guide](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-bluetooth-speakers-portable-speakers-for-every-budget?page=1))

For the best value, consider the **JBL Flip 6** instead: What Hi-Fi? still rates it highly as a budget pick, especially when its price drops. ([What Hi-Fi?’s budget picks](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/hi-fi/best-budget-bluetooth-speakers))

One caveat: if by “hi-fi” you mean the most detailed, natural sound, a portable Bluetooth speaker is a compromise; the Flip 7 is my pick for the best balance of portability and sound within your budget.

**Best pick: JBL Flip 7**, provided you find it for under $200. What Hi‑Fi? names it the best portable Bluetooth speaker and says it improves on the Flip 6’s sound and features ([their guide](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-bluetooth-speakers-portable-speakers-for-every-budget?page=1)).

If the Flip 7 is over budget, get the **JBL Flip 6**: What Hi‑Fi? calls it a particularly strong value as its price drops ([budget picks](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/hi-fi/best-budget-bluetooth-speakers)).
